svg.title: A profile container follows the user, not the machine
svg.desc: Session host A attaches the user's profile container from an SMB file share such as Azure Files at sign-in and detaches it at sign-out. Session host B attaches the same container when the user signs in there. If the container cannot be attached, the user may get a temporary profile or be blocked from signing in.
svg.text: A profile container follows the user, not the machine
Session host A (virtual machine)
At sign-in, FSLogix attaches the user's container
as a virtual disk. The profile appears at
C:\Users\username, so apps behave as if it were local.
A few items are redirected to the local folder
C:\Users\local_username, which is deleted at sign-out.
At sign-out the container is detached.
Session host B (virtual machine)
In a pooled host pool the next sign-in can land here.
The same container is attached again.
SMB file share
for example Azure Files
This is the storage provider. Its location
is set by VHDLocations.
User 1 folder
profile container (VHDX file)
User 2 folder
profile container (VHDX file)
One container per user holds the whole profile,
including Microsoft 365 data in the
recommended single-container setup.
attach at sign-in
detach at sign-out
attach same container
If the container cannot be attached
Depending on the cause and settings, the user may get a temporary profile or be blocked from signing in. Common causes:
Permissions on the share deny access.
The container is in use in another session.
The share or the container is full.
The session host cannot reach or resolve the share (network or DNS).
The VHDLocations value is wrong or missing.
